newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Foreign direct NZ investment up in yr to Mar 96.
newsitem.headline: Foreign direct NZ investment up in yr to Mar 96.

text.p: Net foreign direct investment in New Zealand was NZ$4.4 billion for the year ended March 1996, compared to a net $4.0 billion for 1995, Statistics New Zealand said on Thursday.
Equity capital investment and reinvestment of earnings were the major contributors.
New Zealand direct investment abroad was a net $0.3 billion disinvestment for the year ended March 1996, compared to a net $2.2 billion investment for 1995.
Major contributors in 1996 were equity capital and other long-term capital.

New Zealand's net portfolio investment flow abroad for the year ended March 1996 was $0.5 billion. For the same period the net portfolio investment flow into New Zealand from overseas was $3.1 billion.

For the year ended March 31, 1996, the flow of net other capital investment into New Zealand by non-residents was $0.3 billion. The net flow of New Zealand's other capital investment abroad was $0.6 billion.
